_README: Fill in `expected` for as many rows as you like, then run:
Actions -> 'Validate Service Time' -> check: reference
Rows left as null are skipped, so partial completion is fine.
WHERE THE NUMBER COMES FROM: open the player's Baseball Reference page.
In the bio block at the top, next to Service Time, B-R shows ONE dated
snapshot -- e.g. '9.051 (01/26)' -- not a per-season s.YYYY column. Read
that figure and enter it exactly as displayed, e.g. "9.051" (years.days,
days zero-padded to 3).
ABOUT `as_of`: it is set to an offseason date matching B-R's snapshot
label. Service time does not accrue between the end of the World Series
and Opening Day, so any date in that window gives the same figure -- the
exact day does not have to match B-R's to the day. If B-R's label moves
to a new offseason, update `as_of` on every row to match.
Nothing is scraped: these are entered by hand on purpose, both to respect
B-R's terms and because a handful of hand-checked figures is enough to
catch a systemic error.
`ours_at_generation` is what THIS project computed as of the day the file
was generated, for reference only. It is NOT the as_of figure and is not
used by the validator -- do not copy it into `expected`, that would make
the check vacuous.
